'''Aina's Kitchen''' (Japanese: '''アイナ{{tt|食堂|しょくどう}}''' ''Aina Cafeteria'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Alola]] [[region]]. It first appeared in ''[[SM002|The Guardian's Challenge!]]''. Aina's Kitchen is located in [[Hau'oli City]] on [[Melemele Island]].

Aina's Kitchen is run by [[Abe]] with the help of his daughter {{an|Mallow}}, and is a popular place to eat. One of its best menu items is [[Pinap Berry|Pinap Juice]].

In ''[[SM039|Mallow and the Forest Teacher!]]'', Aina's Kitchen's popularity led Abe to be interviewed on [[Alola TV]] by {{al|Anna}}. However, Mallow stormed out during the broadcast, having had enough of preparing all of the food for her father.

In ''[[SM072|Sours for the Sweet!]]'', Aina's Kitchen was entered into the [[Alola Bread Festival]]. As a result, Mallow took part alongside her brother [[Ulu]], who had returned from his cooking travels in order to participate. They ultimately won the competition.

In ''[[SM121|A Recipe for Success!]]'', after enjoying serving Pokémon at {{an|Oranguru}}'s [[Oranguru's place|café]], Mallow decided that from now on, Aina's Kitchen will now serve both people and Pokémon. Taking a step towards her dream, Mallow invited her classmates and their Pokémon to a tasting party in ''[[SM145|Dreams of the Sun and Moon!]]'', where she unveiled her latest dish: [[Berry]]-topped {{isl|Poni}} radish, which was well-received.

==Trivia==
* The line revealing the restaurant's name in ''The Guardian's Challenge!'' is changed in the dub to refer to "Mallow's restaurant". However, the English closed captions and the [http://sg.portal-pokemon.com/anime/series/s6/ Pokémon official website for Asia] still refer to it as "Aina's Kitchen", leading several dubs based on the English dub to retain the reference. Later episodes continued to avoid referring to the restaurant by name by referring to it as the '''Family Restaurant'''.
* A picture of the restaurant was shown in a newspaper [[Jessie]] was reading in ''[[JN017|Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!]]''.
* In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] chapter ''[[PASM37|Finale!! The Battle Against the Other Dimension!]]'', [[Mallow]]'s restaurant was [[List of cross-canon references|called]] Aina's Kitchen as well.

===Name origin===
''ʻAina'' is Hawaiian for meal.
